in_sanskrit.name: अमोध
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: अम (am) - not, impossible + स्थो (stho) - to stand + ध (dh) - to be

in_hindi.name: अमोध
in_hindi.meaning: अमेंद (amend) - Immovable, Fixed + ध (dh) - to be
in_hindi.long_meaning: अम (am) - not, impossible + स्थान (sthaan) - place + ध (dh) - to be

in_tamil.name: அமோத
in_tamil.long_meaning: விட (vid) - not + தல் (tal) - to stand + அம் (am) - not

in_marathi.name: Amodh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amodh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Amodh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'amodha' which means 'immeasurable', 'boundless', 'endless'. In Hindu mythology, Amodh is the name of a celestial elephant that supports the world on its back.
